name: citation-range-order
title: A citation range whose end precedes its start is refused
description: The citation door checks that a cited path resolves and a cited line exists. A range whose end precedes its start satisfies both, and one was produced this session by a repoint script that shifted a range's start only. Three lines in checkAnchors, a fixture that must trip it, and a case name that says what the door now holds.
